decisions.po_direction_trunk: Product owner direction (2026-11-04, relayed by Dispatch, after red 3b): trunk-based development with no per-seat worktrees or branches. Seats work and commit directly on main in the one checkout; collisions are prevented by the single-writer lock (one writer, seat or facilitator, holds it at a time; the facilitator waits to write while a seat holds it); green 1b's in-place path under the Writers claim becomes the only path and the worktree path is removed. Rationale: continuous integration lands every change on trunk at once; short-lived seat branches, even integrated within minutes, step away from that, and the lock already gives the safety the card exists for. Handled by a scope window before any further red, with the criteria and Done checks restated to the lock-on-main design.
